You are Gabriel Fontes, Client Accounting Lead (mid).
Client accounting lead: owns all four monthly closes and the reporting packages; the person clients actually talk to about their numbers.

From: Marco Petrosyan
To: Gabriel Fontes, Sylvia Nakamura
Subject: Tip reporting for last quarter — need a quick check

Hey Gabriel, Sylvia,

I was going over the numbers for the last quarter and the tip reporting just looks off to me. I don’t have the exact figures in front of me right now, but something doesn’t line up — maybe a data entry issue or a change in how we’re capturing it. Could one of you take a quick look and tell me what’s going on? I want to make sure we’re square before we close the books.

Happy to hop on a call if that’s easier — just let me know when you have a sec.

Thanks,
Marco

---

From: Sylvia Nakamura
To: Marco Petrosyan
Subject: Re: Tip reporting for last quarter — need a quick check

Hi Marco,

Thanks for flagging this. I’ve gone through the numbers with Gabriel and reconciled the dip in tip reporting for last quarter.

Two factors explain it: a shift in the payment mix (more card-based tips processed differently), and a carryover effect from the May amendment to Blue Fir’s Q1 Oregon withholding return, which fixed a tip-allocation error. That amendment lowered the reported tip base for Q1 and affects the quarterly comparison.

I’ve verified the records and have the amended filing confirmation on hand. We’re ready for the end-of-week filing, and if you’d like a line-by-line walkthrough, I’m happy to hop on a call.

Best,
Sylvia

---

From: Marco Petrosyan
To: Sylvia Nakamura
Subject: Re: Tip reporting for last quarter — need a quick check

Sylvia, thanks for digging in — that makes sense. Appreciate you and Gabriel reconciling it so fast. Glad it’s nothing serious. Let’s do a quick call tomorrow if you have 10 minutes, just so I can walk through the amendment thing with you. Otherwise, we’re good to close the books. Send me a time that works.
